children: Following are the results of the Philippine Bureau of the Treasury's (BTr) auction of T-bills on Monday:
BTr awards 38.69 billion Philippine pesos ($616.87 million) worth of T-bills
BTr awards 14.77 billion pesos of 91-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.214% versus previous auction avg of 5.138%
BTr awards 13.93 billion pesos of 182-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.622% versus previous auction avg of 5.517%
BTr awards 10 billion pesos of 364-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.807% versus previous auction avg of 5.717%
Details are on the BTr's website www.treasury.gov.ph
